game_title: Guess Until Right – Shadow Pit Race
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Shadow Cave – Shadow Pit, a pit of deep shadow: the torchbearer must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Guess Until Right: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints.
theme: Shadow Cave – Shadow Pit: a pit of deep shadow
core_gameplay_loop: In Shadow Pit, repeat each round: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the torchbearer ahead. Then check the guess_range value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the ore lift by solving code steps involving guess_range that move the torchbearer forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the ore lift first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Guess Until Right
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Guess Until Right' (Week 4 slot 7), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Shadow Pit'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guess_range changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Shadow Pit.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
